title: Loops, cardboard walls, anime store, and chicken restaurant, the number 8
content: Last night I had another mall dream. I was with 3 friends and we were walking around the mall. It was a huge area that seemed to go around in circles. It was more of a figure 8. I didn't recognize any of the stores. One of the guys started to talk about the previous times he was at the mall. Every time they would stop to eat there they would find these little black colored figurines inside one of these tiny circular containers that held the ketchup, plastic forks/spoons, and sugar packets. They all had notes attached to them that were directed towards my friend. I'll call him J. We walked around through this looped area and came up to an anime store. J kept on saying that he wanted to find out who was putting those figures there for him to find. This time he was going to talk to the employee there and see if he knew something. I looked into the anime store and notice they had tons of posters, toys, statues, etc, all based on anime I don't think I've ever seen in real life. Behind the counter were some containers with tiny figurines and J mentioned that the ones he kept finding looked like those, but the anime store didn't carry black colored ones. I wanted to go in and look around but J made us all go to the faux KFC. Another friend who I'll call RC, said that they also found one at one of the tables. J ran up to the containers with the spoons and started to look inside it. RC started shoved one of his hands into it. They didn't find a thing. Like magic, an employee appeared out of nowhere and grabbed RC's hand and started yelling at the guys. I remained outside the restaurant with another friend who I'll call M. M started to tell me that the notes were telling J not to eat at the mall. That they would meet up soon. That the mall was not what it seemed. That people would go missing. That they couldn't find the way out and needed his help. J was asking the employee if he ever saw anyone placing the figurines into the containers but the employee kept telling him to go away and that he wasn't allowed to eat there anymore. That's when RC said he could hear voices coming from the wall behind the condiments and spoons. RC and J started to pull the entire counter that held the containers away. It seemed to be stuck to the wall. So when they pulled it away, the wall ripped up. It was cardboard. A hole was in the wall now and you could see right into the anime store. The employees there looked shocked and scared. The chicken place guy yelled at us as I was trying to pull RC away from the wall. The guy kept yelling that we were going to get kicked out. He said something like "Go away or they will make you go away". Just like that I woke up. So has anyone experienced anything like this or come across this area where a fake KFC and anime store stand side by side.? As for the loops, the figure 8? I have seen the number 8 appear within the mall. Other numbers too, but 8 is the one that stands out to me all the time. I'm starting to think that it doesn't represent the number 8, but instead it stands for 'Infinity'. That is what this mall is, isn't it? Anyone else seen numbers, or even the number 8?
